title: 第21章 这不是炼丹，这是看经脉
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
第二天一早，林尘到东街的时候天刚亮透。

    徐老头还没来，棚子里只有苏荇一个人在。

    她正蹲在炼丹炉前面生火，淡绿色长裙的袖口卷到手肘，露出一截细白的手腕。

    她听见脚步声抬起头，看了林尘一眼，没有说“早”，只是从药柜上拿下一本薄薄的册子放在桌上。

    “师父半个时辰后才来。他说你要是来得早，先把这本《百草纲目》看完。清心草、银叶花、蛇涎果——这三种药材的灵纹数量、生长环境、采摘时辰、药性归经，都在里面。看完了他要考。考不过今天不准碰炼丹炉。”

    她顿了顿，从袖子里摸出一块干粮放在册子旁边。

    “没吃早饭的话，这个给你。昨天剩的。”

    林尘接过干粮咬了一口，翻开册子。

    百草纲目是炼丹师入门的基础典籍，记录了一百种常见灵药的详细资料，每一种药材都配有手绘的灵草图，旁边密密麻麻写满了注解。

    清心草的灵纹是五道，不是七道——徐老头昨天问他这个问题的时候是在套他的话。

    银叶花的采摘时辰是卯时三刻，过了这个时间花瓣上的灵纹就会闭合。

    蛇涎果的毒性可以通过高温烘烤来中和。

    他看得不快，但每一页都记住了。

    混沌圣体对灵力波动的感知优势在背诵药性上体现得格外明显——药材的药性本质上就是灵力在植物经脉中的流转方式，对他来说就像看一条河的流向一样直观。

    苏荇生好炉火，走到他对面坐下。

    她把那面小巧的铜镜摆在两人中间，镜面上刻满了极细的丹纹。

    “这面镜叫观火镜，炼丹师用来监测炉内灵力波动的。药材在炉中炼化时灵纹会随温度变化而明灭，观火镜能放大这些变化。师父说真正的炼丹师不是靠眼睛看火候，是靠灵力感知——但灵力感知需要长年累月的练习，观火镜是捷径。”

    她开始逐项讲解炼丹的基本流程：选材、清洗、切制、入炉、控火、收丹。

    每一步都讲得很慢，偶尔停下来等林尘提问，但他问的问题比她预想的要多得多——大部分是关于药性冲突的。

    比如清心草和赤蛇果在炉内会产生什么反应，比如银叶花的灵纹在高温下为什么会闭合。

    “你问的这些不是入门该问的。”

    苏荇把观火镜翻了个面，镜面上映出她的眼睛。

    “正常学徒第一天问的都是火候怎么控制、药材要切多碎这种基础问题。你问的全是药性冲突——清心草和赤蛇果的药性对冲会产生什么毒素、银叶花的灵纹在高温下为什么会闭合。这些问题一般学徒学满半年才会开始问。”

    “我在密室里被三种毒素折磨了大半个晚上，毒素在经脉里打架的感觉我比任何人都清楚。药性冲突不是纸上写的东西，是经脉里实实在在的反应。”

    林尘翻到百草纲目的最后一页，上面手绘了一株他从没见过的药材——叶片呈深紫色，根部结了三个拳头大小的果实，果实表面布满了细密的鳞片。

    “这株药材叫什么。”

    苏荇看了一眼，把观火镜放在一边。

    “紫鳞果。玄阶药材，五柳城附近不产，只有落雁谷的后山才有。剧毒，误食半枚就能让金丹期以下的修士当场毙命。但它和清心草一起炼制成丹后，毒性会转化为药性，专门用来化解火属性毒素——比如火棘丹的副作用。”

    她停了一下，目光在那株药材的图样上多停了一瞬。
content_en:
Early the next morning, it was just dawn when Lin Chen arrived at East Street.

    Old man Xu hasn't come yet, and Su Yun is the only one in the shed.

    She was squatting in front of the alchemy furnace to light the fire. The sleeves of her light green dress were rolled up to her elbows, revealing a thin white wrist.

    When she heard the footsteps, she raised her head and glanced at Lin Chen. She didn't say "morning", but just took a thin booklet from the medicine cabinet and put it on the table.

    "Master will come after half an hour. He said that if you come early, you should read the "Compendium of Herbal Medicine" first. The number of spiritual patterns, growth environment, harvesting time, and medicinal properties of these three medicinal materials, including Qingxincao, Silverleaf Flower, and Snake Fruit, are all in it. After reading, he will take a test. If you fail the test, you are not allowed to touch the alchemy furnace today."

    She paused, took out a piece of dry food from her sleeve and placed it next to the booklet.

    "If you haven't had breakfast, here's this for you. The leftovers from yesterday."

    Lin Chen took the dry food, took a bite, and opened the booklet.

    The Baicao Compendium is the basic classic for alchemists to get started. It records detailed information on one hundred common elixirs. Each medicinal ingredient is accompanied by a hand-drawn elixir sketch, and is densely packed with annotations next to it.

    The spirit patterns of Qingxincao are five, not seven - Old Man Xu was trying to trick him when he asked him this question yesterday.

    The time to pick silver-leaf flowers is at three quarters after three hours. After this time, the spiritual patterns on the petals will close.

    The poisonous nature of the fruit can be neutralized by roasting it at high temperatures.

    He didn't read quickly, but he remembered every page.

    Chaos Holy Body's superiority in perceiving spiritual power fluctuations is especially obvious in reciting medicinal properties - the medicinal properties of medicinal materials are essentially the way spiritual power flows in the meridians of plants. To him, it is as intuitive as seeing the flow of a river.

    Su Yun lit the fire and walked to sit opposite him.

    She placed the small bronze mirror between the two of them. The mirror was engraved with extremely fine elixir patterns.

    "This mirror is called a fire-viewing mirror. It is used by alchemists to monitor the fluctuations of spiritual power in the furnace. When the medicinal materials are refined in the furnace, the spiritual patterns will brighten and fade with the temperature changes. The fire-viewing mirror can amplify these changes. Master said that a real alchemist does not rely on eyes to see the fire, but relies on spiritual perception - but spiritual perception requires years of practice, and the fire-viewing mirror is a shortcut."

    She began to explain the basic process of alchemy step by step: selecting materials, cleaning, cutting, putting into the furnace, controlling the fire, and collecting the elixir.

    She spoke slowly every step of the way, occasionally stopping to wait for Lin Chen to ask questions, but he asked many more questions than she expected - most of them were about drug conflicts.

    For example, what will happen to the Qingxincao and Red Snake Fruit in the furnace? For example, why the spiritual pattern of Silverleaf Flower will close under high temperature.

    "What you are asking is not what you should ask for entry."

    Su Yun turned over the fire-viewing mirror, and her eyes were reflected in the mirror.

    "On the first day, normal apprentices ask basic questions such as how to control the fire and how finely the medicinal materials should be chopped. All you ask are about the conflict of medicinal properties - what toxins will be produced by the conflicting medicinal properties of Qingxincao and Red Snake Fruit, and why the spiritual patterns of Silverleaf Flower will close at high temperatures. Generally, apprentices will only start asking these questions after half a year of learning."

    "I was tortured by three toxins in the secret room for most of the night. I know better than anyone the feeling of toxins fighting in the meridians. The conflict between the properties of the medicine is not something written on paper, but a real reaction in the meridians."

    Lin Chen turned to the last page of the Baicao Compendium. On it was a hand-drawn medicinal plant that he had never seen before - the leaves were dark purple, and there were three fist-sized fruits at the roots. The surface of the fruit was covered with fine scales.

    "What is the name of this medicinal plant?"

    Su Yun took a look and put the fire-viewing mirror aside.

    "Purple scale fruit. Xuanjie medicinal material. It is not produced near Wuliu City. It can only be found in the back mountains of Luoyan Valley. It is highly poisonous. Eating half a piece by mistake can kill a monk below the golden elixir stage on the spot. But after it is refined into an elixir with the Qingxin grass, the toxicity will be converted into medicinal properties, and it is specially used to resolve the side effects of fire-attribute toxins - such as firethorn elixir."

    She paused for a moment, her eyes resting on the pattern of the medicinal plant for a moment.
title_en: Chapter 21 This is not refining elixirs, this is looking at the meridians
